Jericho route desyncs on this release (Great Cavern exits are SW/NE; replaced opening with S,S,S,SW,S; later steps partly no-op but still reached the well). basket (98, Volcano Bottom, walkthrough step 142) not reached within cap -> INCOMPLETE. Negatives: ENTER TEAPOT (That would involve quite a contortion) and SIT ON TEAPOT (You cannot climb onto the china teapot) with parent unchanged in Gazebo; note the Gazebo itself is a room (ENTER GAZEBO = travel).

Planetfall.z3.js.notes: safety web (215) confirmed (GET IN WEB / GET OUT OF WEB, ENTER WEB / STAND UP). ENTER ESCAPE POD from Deck Nine moved the player to room 216 'Escape Pod', NOT to carrier object 228 'escape pod' -> 228 carries VEHBIT but is a door-like scenery stand-in for a room; an Enter offer on it works as travel, not as vehicle entry. 'enter door' replied 'The pod door is closed' (parent unchanged); 'enter kit' was out of scope ('can't see'), so it is weak. bed (196) and large vehicle (98) not reached within cap -> INCOMPLETE.

'enter tent' refused while in the tent; 'enter pickaxe' refused. wooden beam (104), mast hole (108), altar (199), barge (211) are far into the game (walkthrough steps 100-230) -> INCOMPLETE. mast hole and altar look like non-enterable carriers by name; unverified.

Sorcerer.z3.js.notes: bed (128) confirmed (GET UP / GET IN BED / GET OUT OF BED / SIT ON BED / STAND UP). 'enter book' refused 'That would involve quite a contortion!'. car (176, Roller Coaster) and log boat (199, Flume) are deep in the amusement park; second bed (188) unplaced at start -> INCOMPLETE.

Deadline.z3.js.notes: Three distinct carriers confirmed via SIT ON X / STAND UP: bed 211 (guest room and George's bedroom share this one object), toilet 209 (George's Bathroom), four-poster bed 34 (Master Bedroom). Negatives: SIT ON CHAIR and SIT ON SINK 'This isn't the kind of thing to sit on!'. IMPORTANT: ENTER BED is refused ('You hit your head against the bed') and EXIT does not leave; only SIT ON / STAND UP work, so an 'Enter' offer is the wrong verb in Deadline -> offer Sit on/Stand up. bathtub 105 and sofa 200 not tested.
